# LENS_* variables config.go reads that docker-compose.yaml's lens service does not name in its
# `environment:` list (B7.2).
#
# THE REASON EVERY NAME BELOW IS HERE: it is set in lens.env, not in docker-compose.yaml. The lens
# service loads `env_file: lens.env` (#377), so each of these reaches the process in production the
# moment an operator writes it into lens.env beside the checkout; unset, it takes config.go's own
# default. They are NOT forwarded through `environment:` on purpose: `environment:` overrides
# env_file, and both `- NAME=${NAME:-}` and a bare `- NAME` arrive as "" (verified in a real
# container, lens_env_shadow_test.go), so forwarding one would silently discard its lens.env value.
# (.env is different: it feeds only ${VAR} substitution inside docker-compose.yaml.)
#
# TestComposeForwardsEveryLensVarConfigReads fails on any read neither forwarded nor listed here,
# and on a listed name that becomes forwarded or unread, so this list only shrinks. Move a name to
# the curated `environment:` list only if it must be set from .env; then delete its line here and
# keep it out of lens.env.example.
LENS_ANNOTATION_MINTING_ENABLED
LENS_ANTIGAMING_AUTO_REVOKE_ENABLED
LENS_ANTIGAMING_INTERVAL
LENS_ANTIGAMING_SCAN_WINDOW
LENS_AUDIT_EXPORT_INTERVAL
